info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-List Fitness Memberships Status-v2-spec
info.description: The Fitness Membership Status API provides access to the current status of fitness memberships. Users can retrieve detailed information regarding individual memberships, including their activation state, expiration dates, and associated benefits. This API is particularly useful for fitness center administrators and members who need to verify their membership details. By facilitating quick and accurate access to membership information, it enhances user experience and operational efficiency.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of a membership.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current status of a specific membership. The status may include active, expired, pending, or canceled states, providing the necessary information for users regarding their memberships.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the membership status. This body must conform to the specified schema and should include all necessary user or context details as required by the operation.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the current membership status.
